_about: Hand-maintained contract status + 2026-27 cap hits for docs/roster.html. Cap hits from Spotrac's 2026-27 Nuggets cap table (checked against Basketball-Reference team salaries). Update when a signing/waiver/two-way/conversion happens. status: standard | two-way | camp-e10 | camp | waived (waived = release confirmed in NBA.com transaction log while ESPN/nba.com roster pages still list him; build_roster.py hides him and footnotes it; delete the entry once both sources drop him). Never guess a number; use null.

Aaron Gordon.note: Spotrac cap hit. Basketball-Reference lists $33,658,037, which includes $1.68M in unlikely incentives.

Ryan Nembhard.note: Signed two-way Sep 30, 2026 (ESPN/NBA.com/Hoops Rumors); KJ Simpson waived to clear the spot.

Lonnie Walker IV.note: Waived Oct 12, 2026 (non-guaranteed camp deal); cleared waivers Oct 14 per SalarySwish/RealGM. ESPN roster API re-listed him; nba.com does not. Hide until ESPN drops him again.

Steven Crowl.note: Signed-and-waived Oct 14, 2026 per NBA.com transaction log / Hoops Rumors / AP. ESPN roster still lists him; nba.com does not.
